page0.text: Kiritsugu always told me to protect girls, and I don't like seeing kids suffer.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page0:1

page1.text:
"Uh... Well, I think Illya should stay here.
The Holy Grail War isn't over. I want to shelter Illya until the last of the Masters are taken care of."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page1:1

page2.text:
"Yep! If Shirou says so, I'll stay here!"
"Hey! Illya, you're choking me! I can't breathe!"
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page2:1

page3.text: I intend to pry off Illya from me, but before I get a chance, Saber steps over and does it for me.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page3:1

page4.text: "What's with you? You've been getting in my way this whole time. Do you have some sort of problem with me?"
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page4:1

page5.text: "Of course I do! I will never forget what you did to Shirou! And you, Shirou! Do you still not understand that nothing good will come of sheltering Illyasviel!?"
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page5:1

page6.text:
"Mmh. What about it? Illya doesn't have a Servant anymore, so she's not dangerous. She's no longer a Master.
Besides, how would you feel if she got attacked after we abandoned her? Illya's life would be in danger, and the other Masters might gain power from her."
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page6:1

page7.text:
"Ugh...yes, that might be true, but..."
Saber hesitates.
No matter what she says, Saber understands that another Master might attack Illya if we leave her alone.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-01:page7:1
